summary: Ragnarok Online entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Ragnarok Online
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Windows regional service for the chosen server/ruleset

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official Windows client for the selected regional service

primary.version: Current official regional Ragnarok Online service
primary.why: Ragnarok Online is a Windows MMORPG from Gravity, and the official regional services remain the content authority. A current official Windows client is the only honest route for live account/server state.
primary.how_to_play: Use an official regional Windows client such as iRO/WarpPortal where available. Record region, server, Renewal/classic ruleset, episode/update state, account, character build, event state, and cash-shop/VIP status.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat private servers or mobile Ragnarok titles as substitutes for the official Windows MMORPG. Record region and server state.
